title: Is it safe to commit our AI sessions?

steps.caption: The session that built yolo-twice, committed with the code: one line per chapter.
We had the same worry. Search our own prompts for it.
Claude measured the leak first, then chose $PROJECT and ~ for every path.
It built the fix and checked it: one scan alarm was only its own search pattern.
And before committing 37 files: secret hits 0, home paths 0.
The whole fix as a map, for whoever reviews it next.
